Hi Samira — great, 11/10 10:30am PST is on our side. A few quick answers up front so we can use the demo time well:

- Webhook verification: we support HMAC verification of webhook payloads (recommended) and can also accept GitHub App installations when customers prefer scoped access tokens. We can show both during the demo.
- Rate limits / batching: Redwood's serving runtime supports intelligent batching and request shaping; for repo-heavy workloads we recommend our continuous-batching profile + prefix caching. I'll bring a short slide with throughput examples from similar OSS workloads.
- Private deployments & data controls: we offer Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments; in the demo we can briefly outline options and next steps for an eval.

Pre-read attached: redwood-github-integration-overview.pdf (1 page). Agenda for the 30-minute slot:
1) 5m — Quick intros & goals
2) 10m — demo of webhook ingestion + auth modes
3) 10m — rate limit/batching patterns and on-prem considerations
4) 5m — next steps / follow-ups (config docs, POC plan)
